nodes.name: Chemical Reduction and N₂ Annealing of MNN-x
nodes.procedure: Four representative samples were synthesized with different Mo levels, specifically Mo/(Mo+Ni) of 4%, 8%, 16% and 20% at the precursor stage, which are denoted as MNN-X (x = 1,2,3, and 4), respectively. Mo-NiO/Ni (MNN) nanocomposites were synthesized by chemical reduction and annealing in the N₂ atmosphere.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of MNN-x samples show peaks at 44.5°, 51.8°, and 76.4° corresponding to (111), (200), and (220) planes of fcc Ni (JCPDS 04-0850), with additional NiO peaks at 37.2° and 62.9° in MNN-4.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of the MNN-x samples (Figures 2B and S5) show three peaks located at 44.5, 51.8, and 76.4°,which correspond to the (111), (200), and (220) planes of fcc Ni JCPDS 04-0850).

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern of MNN-3 shows one set of diffraction rings attributed to (111), (200), (220), (311), and (331) planes of fcc Ni, indicating polycrystalline Ni.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Only one set of diffraction rings can be observed in a selected area electron diffraction SAED) pattern of MNN-3 (Figure 2C), which are attributed to the (111), (200), (220), (311), and (331) planes of fcc Ni.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show that the samples consist of agglomerated nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy SEM) images (Figure S3) show that the samples consist of agglomerated NPs.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show nanoparticle size of ~40-100 nm; from MNN-1 to MNN-4, Ni region becomes smaller while amorphous layer becomes thicker.
nodes.evidence_snippet: transmission electron microscopy TEM) images (Figure S4) show that the size of the NPs are ∼40−100 nm The TEM images also reveal that from MNN-1 to MNN-4... the Ni region gradually becomes smaller while the amorphous layer becomes thicker.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows Mo-NiO/Ni structure with crystalline Ni (111) planes in Ni region (FFT bright spots) and amorphous Mo-NiO region (no FFT spots); disordered regions and grain boundaries observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) images of the Mo-NiO/Ni structure are shown from a side view in Figure 3B... A fast Fourier transform (FFT) in the Ni region... has two bright spots, attributed to the (111) plane of crystalline Ni. No bright spot is observed in the Mo-NiO region.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM with EDS mapping shows Mo concentrated in outer amorphous layer of particles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: high-angle annular dark field scanning TEM (HAADF-STEM) was conducted, and the energy dispersive Xray spectroscopy (EDS) mapping results are shown in Figure 3E. It is found that Mo is more concentrated in the outer amorphous layer of the particles.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS elemental mapping of MNN-3 shows presence of Ni, Mo, and O, indicating coexistence of Ni and Mo-NiO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDS elemental mapping of MNN-3 shows the presence of Ni, Mo, and O (Figure S7), indicating the coexistence of Ni and Mo-NiO in this sample.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p XPS shows Ni⁰ (852.5 eV, 35.7% to 10.6%) and Ni²⁺ (855.8 eV, shift to higher BE in MNN-3); Mo 3d shows Mo⁴⁺ (229.2 eV), Mo⁵⁺ (230.4 eV), Mo⁶⁺ (232.2 eV) with average valence 5.18 (MNN-1) to 5.58 (MNN-4); O 1s shows strong defect O (531.4 eV) and M-O (529.9 eV).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The peaks located at 852.5 and 855.8 eV were assigned to Ni⁰ and Ni²⁺ in Ni 2p₃/₂, respectively... the intensity of the Ni⁰ peak... gradually decreased from 35.7% to 10.6%... The Mo 3d XPS spectra... 229.2, 230.4, and 232.2 eV, corresponding to Mo⁴⁺, Mo⁵⁺, and Mo⁶⁺... average Mo valence increased from 5.18 (MNN-1) to 5.58 (MNN-4).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES of MNN-3 close to Ni NPs with edge shoulder at 8333 eV; between Ni and NiO indicating NiO presence; Mo K-edge shows lower valence in MNN-3 vs c-Mo-NiO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni K-edge XANES spectrum for MNN-3 (rising edge shoulder at 8333 eV) is close to that of Ni NPs... The adsorption edge of MNN-3 lies between Ni and NiO.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge EXAFS shows Ni-Ni coordination at 2.17 Å for Ni, 2.56 Å for NiO; MNN-3 shows decreased Ni-Ni coordination intensity indicating defects; Ni-O bond in c-Mo-NiO is 1.662 Å vs 1.673 Å in NiO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni and NiO reference samples display... Ni-Ni coordination shell located at 2.17 and 2.56 Å respectively. The decrease in magnitude of Ni-Ni coordination shell intensity of MNN-3 relative to the Ni reference suggests a lower coordination number.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-OES used to investigate elemental composition of nanocomposites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray photoelectron spectra (XPS) and inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectra (ICP-OES) were used to investigate the elemental composition of the nanocomposites.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nyquist plots at -0.2 V vs RHE fitted with Randles circuit show R_ct of 12.5, 8.95, 5.95, 372.9 Ω for MNN-1,2,3,4 respectively.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Nyquist plots were collected at -0.2 V vs RHE (Figure S-C). The semicircle curves can be fitted using a Randles circuit model... The electron-transfer resistances (R_ct) for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3) are 12.5, 8.95, and 5.95 Ω, respectively.
